title: Innocent Panels, Hateful Stories: Evaluating and Detecting Hateful Intent in Multi-Turn Visual Story Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-turn text-to-image models by prompting them with narrative sequences designed to convey racist stereotypes against Black people, East Asians, and Jewish people, followed by human annotation of the completed visual stories to detect emergent hateful intent.

Evaluating multi-turn text-to-image models by prompting them with narrative sequences designed to convey hateful narratives targeting Muslims, and using human evaluators to assess if the resulting image groups collectively express religious hate.

Evaluating multi-turn text-to-image models using prompt sequences targeting LGBTQ+ individuals, with human annotators verifying if the generated multi-panel stories successfully convey hateful implications.

Evaluating the generation of harmful visual narratives targeting children as a vulnerable population through deliberate dark distortions of child-oriented stories, verified by human annotation of the generated image sequences.
